mapper.select: select i.playlist_id, i.video_id, i.seq, i.create_time, v.title, v.dur from media_playlist_item i left join media_video v on v.id = i.video_id where i.playlist_id = #{playlistId} order by i.seq asc
select count(*) from media_playlist_item where playlist_id = #{playlistId} and video_id = #{videoId}
select max(seq) from media_playlist_item where playlist_id = #{playlistId}
mapper.insert: insert into media_playlist_item (playlist_id, video_id, seq, create_time) values (#{playlistId}, #{videoId}, #{seq}, current_timestamp)
mapper.delete: delete from media_playlist_item where playlist_id = #{playlistId} and video_id = #{videoId}
mapper.update: update media_playlist_item set seq = #{seq} where playlist_id = #{playlistId} and video_id = #{videoId}
